red.meaning: This browser does little to stop ads and tracking, so the sites you open in it load theirs freely.
red.free: Incognito Browser blocks ads for free on your Android phone.
red.pro: Blocks the hidden tracking scripts that follow you from site to site.

amber.meaning: Some got through, and that is often the tracking half: the ads are blocked, the tracking behind them isn't.
amber.free: Incognito Browser blocks ads for free on your Android phone.
amber.pro: Blocks that tracking half too, on every site you open in Incognito Browser.

green.meaning: This browser does its job here, but the photos you post can still carry the spot where they were taken.
green.pro: Strips the location and other hidden details from a whole folder of photos at once.

red.meaning: On a real site, each request that loads is the ad network seeing this visit and adding it to your profile.
red.free: Incognito Browser blocks the ads themselves, free, on Android.
red.pro: Blocks the trackers that build that profile, which blocking ads alone leaves running.

amber.meaning: Your blocker caught some, but many blockers stop the ads and let the tracking calls behind them through.
amber.free: Incognito Browser blocks the ads themselves, free, on Android.
amber.pro: Blocks those tracking calls too: the scripts that add each visit to your profile.

green.meaning: That's this browser only: your phone and your other browsers may still feed the same profile.
green.free: Incognito Browser blocks the ads themselves, free, on Android.
green.pro: Blocks the trackers that build ad profiles, in Incognito Browser on your Android phone.

red.meaning: On a site that tracks, each script or invisible image that loads adds a line to the record of what you do.
red.free: Incognito Browser's ad blocker stops the ads, free, on Android.
red.pro: Blocks those tracking scripts and pixels (the invisible images) before they can report the visit.

amber.meaning: Your browser stopped some, but each script or invisible image that still loads reports the visit.
amber.free: Incognito Browser's ad blocker stops the ads, free, on Android.
amber.pro: Blocks the tracking scripts and pixels (invisible images) that get past a blocker built for ads.

green.meaning: Few got through here, so this browser keeps that record short; your phone is a separate question.
green.pro: Blocks the scripts and pixels (invisible images) that keep that record, in Incognito Browser on Android.
